welcome.title: Welcome to iBooster
welcome.subtitle: Transform your iPhone into a performance powerhouse. Get real-time insights and save hours of battery life.

battery.title: Extend Battery Life
battery.subtitle: Discover what's draining your battery and get personalized tips to extend your daily usage by 2+ hours.

storage.title: Free Up Storage
storage.subtitle: Reclaim gigabytes of space with smart analysis and one-tap optimization recommendations.

notifications.title: Stay Optimized
notifications.subtitle: Get timely alerts about performance issues and optimization opportunities before they impact you.

permissionDialog.title: Enable Notifications
permissionDialog.description: Get helpful performance tips and important alerts about your device health. You can change this setting anytime in the app settings.

battery.title: Battery Monitor
battery.notificationThreshold: Get notified when battery drops to {{threshold}}%

tips.title: Battery Tips
tips.description: Tap any tip to learn more about improving your battery life.

brightness.title: Adjust Screen Brightness
brightness.description: Lower screen brightness or enable auto-brightness to save battery life. The display is typically the biggest battery consumer.

backgroundRefresh.title: Manage Background App Refresh
backgroundRefresh.description: Disable background refresh for apps you don't need to update constantly. This prevents unnecessary battery drain.

location.title: Review Location Services
location.description: Turn off location access for apps that don't need it, or set them to 'While Using App' instead of 'Always'.

notifications.title: Optimize Push Notifications
notifications.description: Disable notifications for non-essential apps. Each notification wakes your device and uses battery.

lowPowerMode.title: Use Low Power Mode
lowPowerMode.description: Enable Low Power Mode when your battery is running low. It reduces background activity and visual effects.

storage.title: Storage Analyzer
storage.subtitle: Monitor and manage your app's storage usage

mediaToggle.title: Scan Device Media
mediaToggle.description: Include photos and videos in analysis (requires permission)

largeFiles.title: Large Files
largeFiles.noFilesDescription: Your app storage is clean! Large files (>1MB) will appear here.

cleanup.title: Cleanup Suggestions
cleanup.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} file(s)? This action cannot be undone.

network.title: Network & Performance
network.subtitle: Monitor your connection and optimize network performance

offline.noInternet: Connected to network but no internet access
offline.message: No internet connection. Showing connectivity and troubleshooting tips.

recommendations.poorWifi: High latency on Wi‑Fi. Try moving closer to the router, switching the 2.4/5GHz band, or rebooting your router.
recommendations.poorCellular: High latency on cellular. Check signal strength, toggle Airplane mode, or try a different location.
recommendations.fair: Latency is okay but could be improved. Reduce background activity or try a different network.

wifiOptimization.title: Use Wi-Fi When Available
wifiOptimization.description: Wi-Fi typically provides faster speeds and uses less battery than cellular data. Enable auto-connect for trusted networks.

backgroundAppRefresh.title: Manage Background App Refresh
backgroundAppRefresh.description: Disable background refresh for apps that don't need real-time updates. This saves both data and battery.

streamingQuality.title: Adjust Streaming Quality
streamingQuality.description: Lower video streaming quality on mobile data to reduce data usage and improve performance on slower connections.

appUpdates.title: Update Apps Over Wi-Fi
appUpdates.description: Set app updates to download only over Wi-Fi to preserve cellular data and avoid network congestion.

locationServices.title: Optimize Location Services
locationServices.description: Use "While Using App" location setting for most apps instead of "Always" to reduce background data usage.

cellularData.title: Monitor Cellular Data Usage
cellularData.description: Check which apps use the most data in Settings > Cellular, and disable cellular access for data-heavy apps.

airplaneMode.title: Use Airplane Mode in Poor Signal Areas
airplaneMode.description: In areas with very weak signal, enable airplane mode to prevent battery drain from constantly searching for signal.

networkReset.title: Reset Network Settings If Issues Persist
networkReset.description: If experiencing persistent connectivity issues, try resetting network settings in Settings > General > Reset.

empty.bookmarks: No bookmarked tips yet. Tap the bookmark icon on any tip to save it.
empty.category: No tips found in this category

share.error: Unable to share this tip. Please try again.

batteryBrightness.title: Lower Screen Brightness
batteryBrightness.description: Reducing your screen brightness is one of the most effective ways to extend battery life. Use Auto-Brightness or manually adjust in Control Center.

batteryLowPowerMode.title: Use Low Power Mode
batteryLowPowerMode.description: Enable Low Power Mode when your battery drops below 20% to automatically reduce background activity and extend usage time by hours.

batteryBackgroundRefresh.title: Manage Background App Refresh
batteryBackgroundRefresh.description: Disable background refresh for apps that don't need real-time updates. Go to Settings > General > Background App Refresh.

storagePhotosCleanup.title: Optimize Photos Storage
storagePhotosCleanup.description: Enable 'Optimize iPhone Storage' for Photos to automatically store full-resolution photos in iCloud while keeping smaller versions on your device.

storageAppOffload.title: Offload Unused Apps
storageAppOffload.description: Enable 'Offload Unused Apps' in Settings > App Store to automatically remove apps you don't use while keeping their data.

networkWifiOptimization.title: Use Wi-Fi When Available
networkWifiOptimization.description: Wi-Fi typically provides faster speeds and uses less battery than cellular data. Enable auto-connect for trusted networks.

networkCellularData.title: Monitor Cellular Data Usage
networkCellularData.description: Check which apps use the most data in Settings > Cellular, and disable cellular access for data-heavy apps when needed.

performanceRestart.title: Restart Your iPhone Weekly
performanceRestart.description: Regular restarts clear temporary files and refresh system processes, helping maintain optimal performance and speed.

performanceUpdates.title: Keep iOS Updated
performanceUpdates.description: Install iOS updates promptly to get performance improvements, security fixes, and new features that enhance your device's capabilities.

privacyLocationServices.title: Optimize Location Services
privacyLocationServices.description: Use 'While Using App' location setting for most apps instead of 'Always' to reduce background activity and preserve battery life.

privacyAppPermissions.title: Review App Permissions
privacyAppPermissions.description: Regularly check app permissions in Settings > Privacy & Security to ensure apps only have access to the data they actually need.

generalAccessibility.title: Enable Accessibility Features
generalAccessibility.description: iOS includes powerful accessibility features like VoiceOver, Zoom, and AssistiveTouch that can make your device easier to use.

batteryCycles.title: Battery Health Matters
batteryCycles.content: Your iPhone battery is designed to retain up to 80% of its original capacity at 500 complete charge cycles under normal conditions.

storageOptimization.title: Smart Storage Management
storageOptimization.content: iOS automatically optimizes storage by offloading apps and storing photos in the cloud when space runs low.

networkEfficiency.title: 5G vs Wi-Fi Efficiency
networkEfficiency.content: While 5G is fast, Wi-Fi is still more battery-efficient for most tasks. Your iPhone automatically switches to preserve battery.

performanceBoost.title: Background App Management
performanceBoost.content: iOS intelligently learns your usage patterns and only refreshes the apps you use most frequently in the background.
